title: Dynamical Threshold Theory of Sleep v0.3.2: Claim-Bounded Toy-Network Diagnostics of Sleep-Like Recovery Transitions
description: Public landing and metadata refresh of a claim-bounded toy-network diagnostic archive for Dynamical Threshold Theory of Sleep (DTTS). The package preserves a v0.3.1 integrated manuscript and audit synthesis on sleep-like recovery-transition dynamics, threshold-like gate onset, hysteresis-like persistence, selective protection, perturbation recovery, topology/noise robustness, failure boundaries, rescue-regime classification, and frozen rescue-policy holdout behavior in simplified adaptive networks. This release does not introduce new clinical, medical, biological, or therapeutic claims. It is not a clinical sleep model, medical tool, human/animal-data validation, EEG or wearable-device predictor, treatment guide, sleep-improvement method, or complete biological theory of sleep.
